test_title: PYST 8: SSC JE EE - Reasoning (Held on: 24 March 2021 (Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers in the following set.

15, 240, 270
solution:
The pattern followed here is,

N, (N² + N), (N² + N + 2N)

15, (15² + 15), (15² + 15 + 2 × 15) → 15, 240, 270

Similarly,

11, (11² + 11), (11² + 11 + 2 × 11) → 11, 132, 154

Hence, 11, 132, 154 is the correct.
